## Privacy check

Do not paste private repository names or paths, organization names, commit
messages, SHAs, raw trailers, prompts, email addresses, salts, `config.json`,
or the local database. If the report is security-sensitive, stop and follow
[SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md).
